svg.aria-label: Every mechanism question asked about this repository's changes, one mark each, lit if the commit record answered it

g.text: ▮ answered by the record ▮ not answered one mark = one question
Questions are generated from each change's diff alone and scored against its commit messages by a separate model that never sees the code.
This measures what the record EXPLAINS, not what anyone understood — a written record cannot be evidence of comprehension, which is the point.
Dimmed marks are areas whose estimate is too thin to lean on. Translation and fixture directories excluded. No individual is measured or named.
